name: National Supercomputing Center Changsha (NSCC-CS)
zh: 国家超级计算长沙中心

evidence.summary: The US Commerce Department listed it in February 2015 together with the PLA’s National University of Defense Technology (NUDT), finding that NUDT had used US-origin processors to build the Tianhe-1A and Tianhe-2 supercomputers at the national supercomputing centres in Changsha, Guangzhou and Tianjin, and that those supercomputers were believed to be used in nuclear explosive activities.
Hunan University lists the centre (国家超级计算长沙中心) among its own units.

sources.title: Addition of Certain Persons to the Entity List; and Removal of Person From the Entity List Based on a Removal Request (80 FR 8524, 18 February 2015)
sources.publisher: US Department of Commerce, Bureau of Industry and Security (Federal Register)

history.change: Record created from its listing on the US Entity List; not yet verified.
